Did You Know

How to Access Board and Committee Meeting Videos

Log in to the Palm Hill website, open “Committees of Palm Hill,” then choose Board Meeting Videos or Committee Meeting Videos. Contact the webmaster if you need a site account; allow time after each meeting for videos to be posted.
